name: blonde-selfie-on-sofa
image_purpose: Lifestyle feed selfie and home moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a high-fidelity close-up smartphone selfie in a cozy modern living room.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with platinum-blonde hair in a loose updo and face-framing strands, fair-to-light-tan skin, defined lashes, polished makeup, and a bright smile. She wears a light-blue scoop-neck tank top and cream drawstring pajama pants, reclining comfortably on a soft sectional sofa while holding the phone toward the lens.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 close-up selfie at arm's length, slightly elevated phone perspective, sharp face and upper body with gentle background falloff. Include a textured cream sectional, charcoal velvet pillow, beige pillow, framed black-and-white photograph, and a lamp with a black shade.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm flattering indoor light from the front-left and warm lamp glow in the background, natural facial shadows, inviting relaxed home atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone wide-angle selfie look, 3:4 portrait, realistic skin pores, fabric folds, sofa texture and lamp glow, subtle digital grain, natural dynamic range, no beauty smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-fidelity 3:4 smartphone selfie of one approved adult woman with platinum-blonde hair in a loose updo and face-framing strands, fair-to-light-tan skin, defined lashes, polished makeup, and a bright smile. She wears a light-blue scoop-neck tank top and cream drawstring pajama pants, reclining comfortably on a soft cream sectional sofa while holding the phone toward the lens. Include a charcoal velvet pillow, textured beige pillow, framed black-and-white photograph, and a black-shaded lamp glowing warmly in the background. Slightly elevated phone perspective, soft warm front-left light, realistic skin and fabric texture, gentle background falloff, and cozy inviting home realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
